Trump Pressures Ukraine on Leadership, Threatens Arms Supplies

President Donald Trump has pressured Ukraine to elect a new leader, reportedly suggesting that Ukraine should "ditch" President Volodymyr Zelensky. Trump also threatened to cut off weapon supplies to Ukraine. The Justice Department is investigating several TV networks for possible antitrust violations. Ukraine has reportedly shrugged off Trump's call to replace Zelensky.
